title: Education & studenti
summary: Product requirements for the LocalMind Education vertical: a personal student knowledge graph with GraphRAG tutoring, adaptive study paths, and spaced repetition.
scope: Education vertical (dominio education, estensione del motore knowledge graph)
Graph node types: Corso, Argomento/Modulo, Concetto, Materiale, Chunk/Frammento, Esercizio/Quiz, Flashcard, Obiettivo di apprendimento, Percorso di studio, Esame/Scadenza, Persona, Nota personale
Graph edge/relation types: e_prerequisito_di, spiega, approfondisce, e_esempio_di, appartiene_a, ricorre_in, verifica, contraddice/dibatte, deriva_da, copre, annota, fa_parte_del_percorso, autore_di

Weighted edges: peso 0-1 derived from AI extraction confidence, human confirmation/rejection, co-occurrence, semantic similarity (Qdrant), usage frequency, practice outcomes, source authority, recency decay; immutable versioned weights

MVP feature set: (1) education domain model + wiring; (2) course/material CRUD + /api/v1/education/* + Angular feature; (3) didactic material ingestion (Tika/OCR/Whisper + chunking + Qdrant with provenance); (4) AI concept extraction + edge deduction with confidence weight; (5) human-in-the-loop graph review; (6) interactive personal graph visualization; (7) GraphRAG tutor over own material with source citation; (8) flashcards + basic self-checks; (9) i18n IT/EN enum translation

Evolution features: adaptive study path, knowledge tracing/mastery estimation, graph-anchored spaced repetition, LMS/Drive/Zotero PF4J connectors, shareable course-graph/marketplace, opt-in study groups, Anki/Markdown/JSON export, gap suggestion, private study analytics

Data connectors/sources: manual file upload (DocumentController.upload), monitored local folders (LocalFileSystemScanner + Spring Batch), lecture audio/video (WhisperTranscriptionAdapter), web pages/URL fetch, LMS (Moodle/Google Classroom/Canvas via PF4J plugin), cloud storage (Google Drive/OneDrive/Nextcloud plugin), reference managers (Zotero/Mendeley plugin), academic calendar (calendar module), email (email module), Anki import/export
Personas: Giulia (undergraduate), Marco (master/thesis), Sara (high school), Davide (lifelong learner), Prof.ssa Bianchi (teacher secondary), study groups
Tech reuse: Ollama local LLM default, Qdrant vector store, Tika + Tesseract OCR, PF4J plugin system + marketplace, MySQL graph structure, local-first privacy
